windows.command: if ('${input:debuggerAction}' -match 'dap \(Ozone\)') { Start-Process cmd -ArgumentList '/c start ${workspaceFolder}/Debug/gbd_server/gbd_start_dap_${input:mcuSuffix}.bat'; if (Get-Command Ozone -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Start-Process Ozone -ArgumentList '${workspaceFolder}/Debug/ozone/control-2026-${input:mcuSuffix}.jdebug' } else { Write-Error 'Ozone executable not found in PATH. Please add your Ozone installation directory to your system PATH environment variable.' } } elseif ('${input:debuggerAction}' -match 'jlink \(Ozone\)') { if (Get-Command Ozone -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Start-Process Ozone -ArgumentList '${workspaceFolder}/Debug/ozone/control-2026-${input:mcuSuffix}.jdebug' } else { Write-Error 'Ozone executable not found in PATH. Please add your Ozone installation directory to your system PATH environment variable.' } } elseif ('${input:debuggerAction}' -match 'dap \(Flash\)') { openocd -f Debug/config/openocd_dap_${input:mcuSuffix}.cfg -c 'program cmake-build-debug/control-2026.elf verify reset exit' } elseif ('${input:debuggerAction}' -match 'jlink \(Flash\)') { openocd -f Debug/config/openocd_jlink_${input:mcuSuffix}.cfg -c 'program cmake-build-debug/control-2026.elf verify reset exit' }

args: SEL="${input:debuggerAction}"; MCU="${input:mcuSuffix}"; if [[ "$SEL" =~ ^dap\ \(Ozone\)$ ]]; then open -a Terminal "${workspaceFolder}/Debug/gbd_server/gbd_start_dap_${input:mcuSuffix}.sh"; if command -v Ozone >/dev/null 2>&1; then Ozone "${workspaceFolder}/Debug/ozone/control-2026-${input:mcuSuffix}.jdebug"; elif [ -x "/Applications/SEGGER/Ozone_V340g/Ozone.app/Contents/MacOS/Ozone" ]; then "/Applications/SEGGER/Ozone_V340g/Ozone.app/Contents/MacOS/Ozone" "${workspaceFolder}/Debug/ozone/control-2026-${input:mcuSuffix}.jdebug"; else echo "Ozone executable not found in PATH or Applications.
